data.long_meaning: Aditya is the name of the sun god in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aditya', which means 'sun'. Aditya is considered to be the god of light, knowledge, and power. He is also believed to be the source of all energy and the giver of life. The name Adity carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Adity usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aditya represents the divine light within us, illuminating our path and guiding us towards knowledge and enlightenment. It is a powerful name that inspires strength, courage, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Adity belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adity total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Aditya has significant cultural importance in Hinduism, as he is one of the twelve Adityas (or 'Adityas') in Hindu astronomy, representing the twelve months. Each Aditya is associated with a particular celestial body and month. The sun is considered to be the center of the universe in Hindu cosmology, and it is believed that life on earth thrives because of the sun's energy. As a result, Aditya holds a special place in the Hindu pantheon as the bringer of light and life.
data.spiritual_significance: Aditya is also a highly revered deity in Hindu spirituality. He represents the conscious principle or the pure light of the soul. In Hindu scriptures, Aditya is described as having infinite radiance, illuminating all aspects of creation. Aditya is also believed to bestow knowledge, power, and enlightenment upon those who worship him. He is the embodiment of wisdom, strength, and purity, and many seek his blessings for a fulfilling and successful life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aditya symbolizes the radiant, all-illuminating sun god in Hinduism. It embodies the qualities of light, energy, and life-giving force. The name Aditya is a reminder of the divine light within us, inspiring us to shine brightly in our daily lives.
